company.value: Miro is an AI-enabled visual workspace for innovation, used for strategy, product/service design, and process management across the innovation lifecycle. Miro states that more than 100 million users at 250,000 organizations use the platform.

funding.value: Miro announced a $400M Series C on January 5, 2022, bringing total funding to $476M at a stated $17.5B post-money valuation. The company said it was profitable at that time.

hiring_signals.value: Miro’s careers site describes a global team of more than 1,600 people and shows open positions across multiple hubs, indicating an established, distributed organization.

A current Head of Americas Sales posting calls for leadership of 60+ sellers and leaders across commercial, enterprise, and strategic segments, with a mandate to build a signal-driven revenue engine using product usage, customer insights, and AI.

Miro is building/maintaining enterprise and strategic sales capacity. Its role description explicitly calls for AI-assisted account research, stakeholder mapping, territory strategy, opportunity planning, and sales productivity; it also describes complex, multi-year enterprise deals.

likely_use_case.value: Likely fit: sales-call preparation and account intelligence for Miro’s inbound and enterprise sales motion—especially surfacing account context, stakeholder maps, priorities, and expansion signals. This maps directly to its stated push for AI-supported research and a signal-driven revenue engine.

deal_band.value: Enterprise sales-team deployment, likely above a small-seat pilot; exact budget and buying process are unverified.
